nodes.natural_language: Let the roots be primes p and q. Then p+q=63 and pq=k.
nodes.statement: p + q = 63 and k = p*q for primes p, q

nodes.natural_language: Since 63 is odd, one of p,q is even, hence equal to 2.
nodes.statement: One root is even and hence equals 2

nodes.natural_language: Hence the only possible value is k=122.
nodes.statement: Only possible value of k is 122

nodes.natural_language: The corresponding quadratic x^2-63x+122=0 therefore has both roots prime.
